title: 天文自適應光學~Astronomical adaptive optics
focus: 從 Fried 參數到 Strehl 預算的 VLT／ELT 自適應光學工程~VLT and ELT adaptive-optics engineering from the Fried parameter to the Strehl budget
summary: 以 ESO VLT 自適應光學設施（1170 致動器的變形副鏡）與 ELT 的 2.4 m、5000 餘致動器 M4 為範本：從 r0、Greenwood 頻率與等暈角推出變形鏡與波前感測器的規格，再把擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊與非共光路像差整合成 Strehl 預算，最後以即時控制迴路與天上驗證完成工程交接。~Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.

units.anchor: 大氣湍流與 Fried 參數~Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter
units.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度~Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing
units.mechanism: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。沿視線積分後得到 Fried 參數 r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5)，它是波前相位變異量達到 1 rad² 的孔徑直徑：直徑大於 r0 的望遠鏡，長曝光影像不再隨口徑變銳，而被視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0 限制。因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。~Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0. Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics.
units.model: Paranal 中位視寧度 0.7″（500 nm）：r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm；換到 K 波段 2.2 µm，r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm；K 波段視寧度 FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″，而 8.2 m 望遠鏡的繞射極限 λ/D ≈ 0.055″，差 9.4 倍，這就是 AO 要補回的銳度。~Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover.
units.verify: 用台址的 DIMM（差分影像運動監測儀）量 r0 並換算視寧度，與同時間科學影像的 FWHM 比較；以 MASS 或 SCIDAR 量 C_n²(h) 剖面，積分後核對是否重現 DIMM 的 r0；在兩個波段同時成像，確認 FWHM 比值符合 λ^(−1/5) 的視寧度尺度關係。~Measure r0 with the site DIMM (differential image motion monitor) and convert to seeing, comparing with the FWHM of simultaneous science images; measure the C_n²(h) profile with MASS or SCIDAR and integrate it to check that it reproduces the DIMM r0; image in two bands at once and confirm the FWHM ratio follows the λ^(−1/5) seeing scaling.
units.failure: 把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。~Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails.
units.misconception: 望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。~A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images.

units.anchor: Greenwood 頻率與等暈角~Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle
units.title: 時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求~Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement
units.mechanism: 湍流層被風以速度 v 吹過孔徑，相位圖樣以 Taylor 凍結流假設平移，波前的特徵頻率是 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427·v/r0；若控制迴路的 −3 dB 頻寬是 f_3dB，殘餘的時間誤差為 σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3)。另一個限制是角度：相隔 θ 的兩條視線穿過不同的湍流，殘差 σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3)，等暈角 θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ 由湍流的加權平均高度 h̄ 決定。這兩個量分別規定了波前感測器的幀率與參考星必須離目標多近，也直接引出雷射導星與多共軛 AO 的需求。~Turbulent layers are carried across the aperture by wind at speed v, and under Taylor's frozen-flow hypothesis the phase pattern translates, giving the wavefront a characteristic Greenwood frequency f_G = 0.427·v/r0; with a control −3 dB bandwidth f_3dB, the residual temporal error is σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3). The other limit is angular: two lines of sight separated by θ cross different turbulence, leaving σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3) with the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ set by the turbulence-weighted mean height h̄. These two quantities fix the wavefront-sensor frame rate and how close the reference star must be, and lead directly to laser guide stars and multi-conjugate AO.
units.model: 取 v = 10 m/s、h̄ = 5 km：500 nm 時 f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz，K 波段 f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz；若 f_3dB = 50 Hz，K 波段時間誤差 σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²；等暈角 θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″（K），在 500 nm 只有 1.9″；相干時間 τ0 = 0.314·r0/v 在 500 nm 為 4.5 ms。~With v = 10 m/s and h̄ = 5 km: at 500 nm f_G = 0.427×10/0.144 ≈ 30 Hz and at K band f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 ≈ 5.0 Hz; for f_3dB = 50 Hz the K-band temporal error is σ_t² = (5.0/50)^(5/3) ≈ 0.022 rad²; the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314×0.85/5000 ≈ 5.3×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 11″ at K but only 1.9″ at 500 nm; the coherence time τ0 = 0.314·r0/v is 4.5 ms at 500 nm.
units.verify: 從波前感測器遙測資料算各模態的時間功率譜，擬合其轉折頻率與 f_G 預測比較；以 MASS-DIMM 的 τ0 與 θ0 統計核對台址模型；在不同離軸角放置參考星觀測同一目標，量 Strehl 隨角度的下降並擬合 (θ/θ0)^(5/3)。~Compute the temporal power spectra of the modes from wavefront-sensor telemetry and compare their knee frequencies with the predicted f_G; check the site model against MASS-DIMM statistics of τ0 and θ0; observe a target with reference stars at several off-axis angles, measure the Strehl fall-off and fit (θ/θ0)^(5/3).
units.failure: 高空急流讓有效風速從 10 m/s 升到 30 m/s，f_G 增為三倍，固定 50 Hz 頻寬的迴路殘差 σ_t² 增為 3^(5/3) ≈ 6.2 倍，Strehl 在不改任何硬體的情況下崩落。~A jet stream raising the effective wind speed from 10 to 30 m/s triples f_G, the residual σ_t² of a fixed 50 Hz loop grows by 3^(5/3) ≈ 6.2, and the Strehl collapses without any hardware change.
units.misconception: 只要參考星夠亮，離目標多遠都能用來校正。~A bright enough reference star can correct a target no matter how far away it is.

units.anchor: 變形副鏡與 ELT M4~Deformable secondary and ELT M4
units.title: 變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差~Deformable mirrors: actuator density, stroke and fitting error
units.mechanism: 變形鏡以一片薄殼承載連續反射面，由音圈致動器以電容感測閉迴路定位：VLT 的變形副鏡在約 1.1 m 的薄殼上有 1170 個致動器，ELT 的 M4 則是 2.4 m 平面鏡、六片 1.95 mm 厚的玻璃陶瓷薄殼、5000 餘個音圈致動器，每秒更新 1000 次、行程 ±50 µm。致動器投影到主鏡的間距 d 決定可校正的最高空間頻率，殘餘的擬合誤差 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3)；致動器總數因此按 (D/d)² 隨口徑平方成長，行程則必須涵蓋湍流的峰谷值加上望遠鏡自身的像差與風擾。~A deformable mirror carries a continuous reflective facesheet on a thin shell positioned in closed loop by voice-coil actuators with capacitive sensing: the VLT deformable secondary has 1170 actuators behind a shell of about 1.1 m, while the ELT M4 is a 2.4 m flat built from six 1.95 mm glass-ceramic shells with more than 5000 voice coils, updated 1000 times per second with ±50 µm of stroke. The actuator pitch d projected onto the primary sets the highest correctable spatial frequency, leaving a fitting error σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3); the actuator count therefore grows as (D/d)², with the square of aperture, and the stroke must cover the turbulence peak-to-valley plus telescope aberrations and wind shake.
units.model: VLT：瞳面積 π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m²，52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m²／致動器，投影間距 d ≈ 0.21 m；K 波段 r0 = 0.85 m，σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad²。ELT：有效瞳面積約 1100 m²，1100/5316 ≈ 0.21 m²，d ≈ 0.45 m，σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.45/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.097 rad²，單由擬合項得到 Strehl ≈ 0.91。~VLT: pupil area π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m², 52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m² per actuator, projected pitch d ≈ 0.21 m; with r0 = 0.85 m at K, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad². ELT: effective pupil area about 1100 m², 1100/5316 ≈ 0.21 m², d ≈ 0.45 m, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.45/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.097 rad², a Strehl of ≈ 0.91 from the fitting term alone.
units.verify: 以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯；對薄殼施加 Zernike 組合並量閉迴路後的面形殘差；用電容感測器的讀值做迴路頻率響應，確認 1 kHz 更新下的穩定餘裕；以高解析度干涉圖計算實際擬合誤差並與 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3) 比較。~Measure each actuator's influence function and inter-actuator coupling with an interferometer, confirming stroke, linearity and hysteresis; command Zernike combinations on the shell and measure the closed-loop figure residual; use the capacitive-sensor readings for a loop frequency response to confirm stability margins at 1 kHz update; compute the actual fitting error from high-resolution interferograms and compare with 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3).
units.failure: 薄殼上單一致動器失效或電容感測器漂移，鄰近區域出現固定的面形凸起，造成 PSF 的對稱斑點；若行程預算未含望遠鏡風擾與主鏡像差，致動器在壞視寧度下飽和，迴路發散。~A single failed actuator or a drifting capacitive sensor on the shell leaves a fixed bump that produces symmetric speckles in the PSF; if the stroke budget omits wind shake and primary-mirror aberrations, actuators saturate in poor seeing and the loop diverges.
units.misconception: 致動器越多越好，數量不會受其他因素限制。~More actuators are always better and nothing else limits the count.

units.anchor: Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機~Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera
units.title: 波前感測器、光子雜訊與參考星亮度~Wavefront sensors, photon noise and guide-star brightness
units.mechanism: Shack–Hartmann 感測器用微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個子孔徑的光點位移正比於該處的波前斜率；金字塔感測器則在焦點放一個四面稜鏡，以四個瞳影像的強度差量斜率，對小像差的靈敏度更高。光點位置的量測受光子雜訊限制，每個子孔徑每幀只有數十到數百個光子，所以必須用讀出雜訊低於 1 e⁻ 的 EMCCD 或專用低雜訊紅外偵測器（ELT 的 LISA 由 ESO 與 Teledyne 共同開發）。感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。~A Shack–Hartmann sensor divides the pupil into subapertures with a lenslet array, and the spot displacement in each subaperture is proportional to the local wavefront slope; a pyramid sensor instead places a four-sided prism at the focus and measures slopes from intensity differences between four pupil images, with higher sensitivity to small aberrations. Spot positioning is photon-noise limited, with only tens to hundreds of photons per subaperture per frame, so EMCCDs with sub-electron read noise or dedicated low-noise infrared detectors (the ELT's LISA was co-developed by ESO and Teledyne) are required. Phase error at the sensing wavelength scales to the science band by (λ_s/λ_sci)².
units.model: 子孔徑 d ≈ r0 時光點接近繞射極限，光子雜訊相位變異約 σ_ph² ≈ π²/(2N_ph)：N_ph = 500 光子／子孔徑／幀 → 0.0099 rad²（700 nm 感測），換到 K 波段乘 (0.7/2.2)² ≈ 0.10 得 0.0010 rad²。亮度預算：R = 10 等星約 7×10⁵ 光子/s/m²（100 nm 帶寬，教學值），0.045 m² 子孔徑在 1 kHz 下每幀 32 光子，乘 0.3 的通量效率只剩約 10 光子，σ_ph² ≈ 0.49 rad² → K 波段 0.05 rad²，所以全速 NGS AO 需要約 R < 9 的星。~For d ≈ r0 the spot is near diffraction-limited and the photon-noise phase variance is about σ_ph² ≈ π²/(2N_ph): N_ph = 500 photons per subaperture per frame → 0.0099 rad² at 700 nm sensing, or 0.0010 rad² at K after multiplying by (0.7/2.2)² ≈ 0.10. Brightness budget: an R = 10 star gives about 7×10⁵ photons/s/m² in a 100 nm band (teaching value), a 0.045 m² subaperture at 1 kHz collects 32 photons per frame, and a throughput of 0.3 leaves about 10, giving σ_ph² ≈ 0.49 rad² → 0.05 rad² at K, so full-speed NGS AO needs stars brighter than about R = 9.
units.verify: 以內部光源量每個子孔徑的光點重心對已知傾斜的響應，取得像素尺度與線性範圍；逐步衰減光源量重心雜訊對光子數的關係，確認 σ ∝ 1/√N_ph；用 ⁵⁵Fe 或光子轉移曲線量相機的增益與讀出雜訊；在天上對不同星等的星做閉迴路，記錄 Strehl 對星等的曲線並找出轉折。~Measure each subaperture's centroid response to known tilts with an internal source to obtain pixel scale and linear range; attenuate the source stepwise and record centroid noise versus photon count to confirm σ ∝ 1/√N_ph; measure camera gain and read noise with a photon-transfer curve; close the loop on sky on stars of different magnitudes and record the Strehl-versus-magnitude curve to find the knee.
units.failure: 微透鏡陣列相對瞳面偏移半個子孔徑，邊緣子孔徑被部分遮蔽，其斜率被系統性低估，重建出的波前帶有固定的低階像差，PSF 出現無法消除的彗差或像散。~A lenslet array shifted by half a subaperture relative to the pupil partially vignettes the edge subapertures, their slopes are systematically underestimated, the reconstructed wavefront carries a fixed low-order aberration and the PSF shows coma or astigmatism that cannot be removed.
units.misconception: 波前感測器的量測精度只取決於相機的像素大小。~Wavefront-sensor accuracy depends only on the camera's pixel size.

units.anchor: 交互矩陣與非共光路校正~Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration
units.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正~Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration
units.mechanism: 控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。~The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor. A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain.
units.model: 量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。NCPA 殘差 50 nm rms 在 K 波段對應 σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad²，Strehl 損失約 2%；若未校正而殘留 150 nm，σ² ≈ 0.18 rad²，Strehl 損失 17%。~Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time. An NCPA residual of 50 nm rms corresponds at K to σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad², a Strehl loss of about 2%; left uncalibrated at 150 nm, σ² ≈ 0.18 rad² and the loss is 17%.
units.verify: 比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。~Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets.
units.failure: 交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。~An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation.
units.misconception: 感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。~Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl.

units.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比~Error budget and the Strehl ratio
units.mechanism: AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。主要項目是擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊、混疊（感測器對高頻的錯誤取樣，約為擬合項的三成）、非等暈、NCPA 與色散；影像抖動（tip-tilt 與振動）不屬於小像差，另以 S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²] 的因子乘上。預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。~AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent. The main terms are fitting, temporal delay, measurement noise, aliasing (the sensor mis-sampling high frequencies, roughly 30% of the fitting term), anisoplanatism, NCPA and chromatic effects; image jitter from tip-tilt and vibration is not a small aberration and is applied as a separate factor S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²]. The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing.
units.model: K 波段、亮 NGS 在軸上：擬合 0.028 + 時間 0.022 + 量測 0.001 + 混疊 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + 色散與其他 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915；抖動 σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad，λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad，S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86；總 Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79。換到 H 波段（1.65 µm）各項乘 (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78，σ² = 0.158 → 0.85，S_j ≈ 0.78，總 Strehl ≈ 0.66。~K band, bright on-axis NGS: fitting 0.028 + temporal 0.022 + measurement 0.001 + aliasing 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + chromatic and other 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915; jitter σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad with λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad gives S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86; total Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79. At H band (1.65 µm) every term is multiplied by (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78, σ² = 0.158 → 0.85, S_j ≈ 0.78, total Strehl ≈ 0.66.
units.verify: 從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。~Reconstruct the residual wavefront from closed-loop telemetry, decompose it by mode and compare each variance with the budget line by line; measure the actual Strehl from the science-camera PSF normalised to the same total flux as the diffraction-limited PSF; estimate the jitter term from accelerometer vibration spectra of the telescope; repeat under different seeing and plot Strehl versus r0 against the budget model.
units.failure: 預算表漏掉望遠鏡振動（例如冷卻泵或風造成的 20–50 Hz 峰），量測的 Strehl 比預算低 20% 卻找不到波前殘差的來源，直到用加速度計與感測器遙測的交叉譜才發現是抖動項。~A budget that omits telescope vibration, such as 20–50 Hz peaks from cooling pumps or wind, measures a Strehl 20% below prediction with no visible wavefront residual to blame, until cross-spectra of accelerometers and sensor telemetry reveal the jitter term.
units.misconception: Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。~Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators.

units.anchor: 即時控制器與迴路延遲~Real-time controller and loop latency
units.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度~Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin
units.mechanism: 即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。~Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power. ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second.
units.model: f_s = 1 kHz、增益 g = 0.5：交越頻率 ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz；延遲 τ_d = 2 幀 = 2 ms 在 80 Hz 造成 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° 落後，相位裕度 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°；要維持 45° 裕度，f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz，對應 g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39。運算量：2480 個斜率 × 1170 致動器 ≈ 2.9×10⁶ 次乘加／幀，1 kHz 下 2.9 GMAC/s；ELT 約 10⁴ 斜率 × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷／幀，500 Hz 下 27 GMAC/s。~f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39. Computation: 2480 slopes × 1170 actuators ≈ 2.9×10⁶ multiply-accumulates per frame, 2.9 GMAC/s at 1 kHz; for the ELT about 10⁴ slopes × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷ per frame, 27 GMAC/s at 500 Hz.
units.verify: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。~Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction.
units.failure: 為了追求頻寬把增益調到 0.8，相位裕度降到接近零，抑制函數在 100–150 Hz 出現 +6 dB 的過衝峰，正好放大望遠鏡振動與風擾，殘差反而比低增益時更大。~Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain.
units.misconception: 即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。~A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth.

units.anchor: 天上驗證與遙測紀錄~On-sky validation and telemetry record
units.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接~On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 系統在天上的驗證包含：對不同星等與離軸角的參考星閉迴路，量 Strehl、FWHM 與包圍能量；同步記錄感測器與變形鏡遙測，重建殘餘相位的功率譜並反推 PSF；在一系列視寧度與相干時間下建立效能對台址條件的統計。交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。~On-sky validation closes the loop on reference stars of different magnitudes and off-axis angles, measuring Strehl, FWHM and encircled energy; sensor and deformable-mirror telemetry are recorded synchronously to reconstruct the residual-phase power spectrum and infer the PSF; performance statistics are built against site conditions across a range of seeing and coherence time. The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration.
units.model: 量到 Strehl 後反推殘差：σ = √(−ln S)，S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad，在 K 波段為 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms；S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm。操作上限：視寧度 1.2″ 時 r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm，擬合項放大 (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 倍到 0.068 rad²，時間項同樣放大，K 波段總 σ² 從 0.089 升到約 0.21，Strehl 降到 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70（仍可用）；視寧度 2″ 則 σ² ≈ 0.5，Strehl 約 0.5。~Back out the residual from a measured Strehl: σ = √(−ln S), so S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad, which at K is 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms; S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm. Operating ceiling: at 1.2″ seeing r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm, the fitting term grows by (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 to 0.068 rad² and the temporal term likewise, the K-band total σ² rises from 0.089 to about 0.21 and the Strehl drops to 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70, still usable; at 2″ seeing σ² ≈ 0.5 and the Strehl is about 0.5.
units.verify: 對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。~Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone.
units.failure: 交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。~If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared.
units.misconception: 感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。~Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed.

example: Strehl 預算練習：VLT 8.2 m，K 波段 2.2 µm，視寧度 0.7″（r0 = 14.4 cm @ 500 nm → 85 cm @ K），風速 10 m/s，變形副鏡 1170 致動器（投影間距 0.21 m），迴路 1 kHz、f_3dB = 50 Hz，亮 NGS 在軸上。擬合：0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) = 0.028 rad²；時間：f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 = 5.0 Hz，(5.0/50)^(5/3) = 0.022；量測：500 光子／子孔徑／幀，π²/(2×500)×(0.7/2.2)² = 0.001；混疊 0.008；NCPA 50 nm → (2π×50/2200)² = 0.020；其他 0.010。總 σ² = 0.089 → exp(−0.089) = 0.915；抖動 10 mas → S_j = 0.86；Strehl ≈ 0.79。若參考星暗到每幀只剩 10 光子，量測項升到 0.05，σ² = 0.138 → 0.871×0.86 ≈ 0.75；若視寧度變成 1.2″，擬合與時間項各乘 2.45，σ² ≈ 0.21 → Strehl ≈ 0.70。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際系統的規格。~Strehl-budget exercise: VLT 8.2 m, K band at 2.2 µm, seeing 0.7″ (r0 = 14.4 cm at 500 nm → 85 cm at K), wind 10 m/s, a 1170-actuator deformable secondary (projected pitch 0.21 m), a 1 kHz loop with f_3dB = 50 Hz and a bright on-axis NGS. Fitting: 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) = 0.028 rad²; temporal: f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 = 5.0 Hz, (5.0/50)^(5/3) = 0.022; measurement: 500 photons per subaperture per frame, π²/(2×500)×(0.7/2.2)² = 0.001; aliasing 0.008; NCPA 50 nm → (2π×50/2200)² = 0.020; other 0.010. Total σ² = 0.089 → exp(−0.089) = 0.915; jitter 10 mas → S_j = 0.86; Strehl ≈ 0.79. If the guide star fades to 10 photons per frame the measurement term rises to 0.05, σ² = 0.138 → 0.871×0.86 ≈ 0.75; if seeing worsens to 1.2″ the fitting and temporal terms each grow by 2.45, σ² ≈ 0.21 → Strehl ≈ 0.70. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real system's specification.
history: Horace Babcock 於 1953 年提出以可變形鏡即時補償大氣擾動的構想；1970–80 年代的軍方研究發展出 Shack–Hartmann 感測與變形鏡技術，1991 年解密後進入天文。ESO 在 1989 年於 3.6 m 望遠鏡以 COME-ON 系統首次取得天文 AO 影像，之後 Keck、VLT NACO 相繼投入；2016–2017 年 VLT 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器變形副鏡與四雷射導星啟用，ELT 的 2.4 m M4 則把致動器數推到 5000 以上。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~Horace Babcock proposed in 1953 that a deformable mirror could compensate atmospheric distortion in real time; military research in the 1970s and 1980s developed Shack–Hartmann sensing and deformable-mirror technology, released to astronomy after declassification in 1991. ESO obtained the first astronomical AO images with the COME-ON system on its 3.6 m telescope in 1989, followed by Keck and VLT NACO; in 2016–2017 the VLT Adaptive Optics Facility entered service with a 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, and the 2.4 m M4 of the ELT pushes the actuator count beyond 5000. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only.
